dct_description_sm: Active Transportation layer is the combination of both the Pedestrian and Bicycle Networks. The Pedestrian Network includes the following facility types: Shared-Use Pathway, Paved; Shared-Use Pathway, Unpaved; and Sidewalk. The Bicycle Network includes the following facility types: Cycle Track; Shared-Use Pathway, Paved; Shared-Use Pathway, Unpaved; and Bike Lane. Dataset updated continuously.
